text_block_list.text:
At dusk. While taking a leisurely stroll
through town with Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ What is that?
There's a crowd gathering up ahead.
It looks like some kind of ceremony~

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
You there, quiet young lady,
wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, is it really fine for me to draw
one as well? Then, don't mind if I do~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Trainer-sama, would you not require
a ticket to participate in the lottery?
choice_data_list: I have exactly five supplementary tickets.
I have exactly five supplementary tickets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, as expected of you~.
So that means we get to draw 5 times, right?

"...You can only draw once.
I managed to convince them to settle for that, however."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-sama.
Let us turn this little Ferris wheel together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here we go~, round and round~♪

I spin the lottery wheel at an ultra-slow pace.
The result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......Whoaaa~, it feels like...
something incredible just happened~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd receive a hot spring ticket...
I don't own my own hot spring, you see,
so I've always used the Mejiro family's~."
choice_data_list: It's not the hot spring itself, it's a voucher for a hot spring trip, yeah.
It's not the hot spring itself, it's a voucher for a hot spring trip, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Even with the grand prize, they wouldn't just hand over a literal hot spring.
Still, I had won the ultimate prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip~♪ Since we were kind enough
to receive it, I'd like to go as soon as possible,
Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll start getting ready once I'm back... and, umm~
let's see, we should be able to depart by...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Around the beginning of next year, perhaps~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~? But if we plan our trip while still
making sure to get solid results in our races,
it feels like that's about how long it'd take~?
Balancing both would take a year. That seems to be Mejiro Bright's sense of pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um... How does your schedule look a year from now,
Trainer-sama?
choice_data_list: I don't get it, but OK!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, wonderful.
Shall we head over together, then~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'd be glad if you could hold onto the voucher until that day~. Next year, I'd love to warm myself right up in the hot springs, nice and toasty~.
She now had something wonderful to look forward to. Dreaming of the hot spring trip, Mejiro Bright's expression was already utterly blissful.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My, that looks delicious~.
What a remarkably large hamburger steak."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you do not mind,
would you allow me to handle the grilling~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, things like this need to be grilled slowly
and thoroughly, or they won't cook through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "If anything, a personality like mine might be better suited for cooking~."
choice_data_list: How are you planning to cook it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Let me see~. After heating the pan slightly,
you let it cook slowly over low heat~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...About 2 hours♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you think so?
Finding the right balance sure is tricky~.

"...I'll take care of the cooking duties.
After returning to Tracen Academy, Mejiro Bright savored a fluffy, freshly grilled hamburg steak."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~, to receive so much.
Peeling all of these will be quite a chore~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer, when I peeled a daikon radish before, I did it rather skillfully, you know?
choice_data_list: Huh, so you're good at that?
Huh, so you're good at that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm particularly skilled at it, but
when I carefully peeled it very thinlyâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eventually, the fruit inside was all gone, and it turned into one long peel~

Her speed may be slow, but it does not
seem to be a matter of clumsiness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I could turn all these
carrots into one sheet as well...

No use obsessing over mastering rotary peeling.
The two of us just stewed it normally and ate it.
The meat was incredibly sweet and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: One stick... I am so terribly sorry, it is my fault that we did not win anything very good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's only a small portion, so I feel like
gobbling it all up right now, though~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is... I am not particularly fond of eating while walking about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I just can't eat while walking~.
I always end up stopping in my tracks...
choice_data_list: Shall we eat around there, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this spot would be lovely~.
The two of us watching the sunset together—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's split it in half, Trainer.
The sun looks just like a carrot too, doesn't it~...
Looking out at the evening scenery, the two of them ate together. They savored the heartwarming sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa... Pocket tissues~? If I could get a whole lot of them, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just one will be used up in no time.
Trainer, surely you'd like a few more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, by way of apology, the Mejiro family
shall send you a gift next time.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that's a big help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: About the length of a truck~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I see~. I felt like doing at least that much wouldn't even begin to make up for it, but...

She looks down with an apologetic expression. It ended
in an undeniably disappointing result...
